source_description_html:
Maintaining its legendary comfort, the FASTBACK ENDURANCE now comes with a specially designed sole for enduro enthusiasts. This key feature ensures these boots remain a pleasure to wear in all conditions, combining comfort with the durability and traction needed for challenging enduro terrains.
The “wrap-around” ankle pivot system provides strong lateral support without compromising flexibility.
The boot features a PU-injected front shin plate, anatomically shaped to offer robust support. Additional safeguards on the heel guarantee support in the event of rear compression. Optimal control in the toe area is guaranteed with the shift lever. Microfiber inserts strategically placed on the instep areas contribute to flexibility and overall comfort.
On the inner side, suede leather ensures exceptional grip on the bike and is heat-resistant, providing optimal control and reliable protection during rides.
The Closure System consists of four lightweight and replaceable buckles, with Velcro on top ensuring easy, fast, and precise closure. The first two buckles at the top can be unscrewed and adjusted to accommodate a larger leg or knee brace, offering enhanced versatility.
The internal padding provides a luxurious feel, enhanced by soft foam reinforcements strategically placed around the ankles and instep to ensure long-lasting comfort.
The Gaerne Goodyear Welted artisanal construction, a technique consistently employed by Gaerne since 1962, ensures the creation of a robust and durable sole structure. This commitment to quality craftsmanship and longevity has become a cornerstone of Gaerne motocross boots. Furthermore, this construction method allows for easy resoling, offering an opportunity to breathe new life into the boots. Our unwavering dedication to Goodyear Welted construction is a testament to our commitment to maintaining exceptional standards in our products.
The Composite Sole on the Enduro version is crafted with a dedicated tread, providing exceptional grip on cross-pegs, especially in wet and muddy terrains. This tailored sole design enhances performance, delivering reliable traction and optimal functionality for the demands of enduro riding.
The FASTBACK ENDURANCE ENDURO boot is CE certified in accordance with EN 13634:2017 and Regulation EU 2016/425.
The FASTBACK ENDURANCE ENDURO boot is proudly Made in Italy.

The GX1 EVO off-road boot, celebrated for its advanced technology and protection-focused design, now introduces a lighter version that offers instant comfort from the first wear.
It is equipped with a robust structural support system featuring the ATP (Anti-Torsion Pocket) technology. This design includes two lugs that glide within specially designed pockets, effectively preventing overextension while allowing natural forward and backward flex.
For added protection, the boot boasts a PU-injected front shin plate, anatomically shaped for optimal support. Side air vents help keep feet dry, ensuring maximum comfort throughout the ride. Inside, stamped suede on the inner panel provides exceptional grip and is heat-resistant, enhancing control and protection during rides.
The Closure System is designed for efficiency and versatility, with four lightweight, replaceable buckles and a top Velcro strap for easy, quick, and secure adjustments. The top two buckles are adjustable, accommodating larger legs or knee braces, offering a custom fit and greater versatility.
Inside, soft padding with foam reinforcements around the ankles and instep ensures long-lasting comfort.
The GX1 EVO boots feature the G.Light Welt Sole, renowned for its high-performance rubber that enhances grip. This sole heightens sensitivity to the brake and shifter, providing riders with precise control and responsiveness. Additionally, its easily replaceable design adds convenience to maintenance, ensuring longevity and durability.
The GX1 EVO boot is CE certified in accordance with EN 13634:2017 and Regulation EU 2016/425
The GX1 EVO boot is proudly Made in Italy.

source_description_html:
The GP1 EVO racing boots epitomize over sixty years of Italian excellence and passion in the thrilling world of racing. Representing the pinnacle of the Racing line, the GP1 EVO motorcycle boot is the result of collaboration between Gaerne's R&D and professional riders, standing as a testament to the company’s commitment to innovation and performance.
The carbon composite Gaerne Floating Pivot System (GFPS) provides superior lateral support preventing over-compression and hyper-extension, while allowing the rider’s foot to feel natural on the peg.
The adjustable closure system around the calf, featuring a replaceable BOA IP1 reel, enables a custom fit, accommodating larger sizes. The closure is complemented by an internal zip that works in synergy with an elastic insert near the ankle area, facilitating the closure of the boot. The inner side rubber Grip Guard enhances grip with the bike and shields the leg from engine/exhaust heat.
The lightweight upper is crafted with Microfiber, a high-tech material engineered for optimal abrasion resistance. Elasticized instep inserts ensure a snug fit, providing a high level of comfort and enhancing natural front and back movement. The replaceable PU-injected Front Shin Plate is anatomically shaped to provide robust support, featuring an interchangeable nylon front shin plate slider. Additionally, the PU shifter protection ensures maximum sensitivity during gear-shifting while also offering additional toe support.
Inside, the boot features a breathable inner lining and incorporates strategically designed ankle area padding with varying thicknesses, ensuring maximum comfort.
The removable and washable innersole, anatomically designed, ensures full support for all parts of the foot.
Sole featuring a multi density tread with distinct grip areas and profile integrated with the upper, the design ensures superior traction on foot pegs and controls, coupled with increased durability against wear and abrasion from asphalt. Additionally, interchangeable magnesium sliders on the toe and heel facilitate smooth sliding upon contact with the asphalt.
The GP1 EVO boot is CE certified in accordance with EN 13634:2017 and Regulation EU 2016/425.
The GP1 EVO boot is proudly Made in Italy.

source_description_html:
Gaerne SG-12: Quality, comfort, pride!
Choises create champions, but support is what keeps them at the top, which is why the SG-12 boot is the choice for riders who aspire to rise above the competition. From box to bike with minimal break-in, Gaerne's SG-12 boots are made in Italy by practiced hands that step-by-step layer support, security and comfort into each boot. The premium SG-12 offers a streamlined toe box for precision control, a dual-stage pivot system for more aggressive riders, an anti-shock composite sole for besser connection to the pegs, slimline inner grip guard panels for better control and grip of the bike, memory foam interior for a customized fit, and an adjustable shin plate for more room aroung the calves. The buckle system makes it easy to get in and get going, so a rider can focus less on gear and more on the ride.

Series:
  • MX Line

    • Features:
  • sizes: 41 - 49
  • enduro version
  • lightweight alloy buckles
  • grip guard (exceptional grip of the bike, as well as offering a heat resistant padding against your inner leg)
  • dual composite sole (anti-shock rubber that has made Gaerne soles famous around the world)
  • front plate/shin guard (the thermoplastic shin plate is anatomically shaped for a perfect fit)
  • by removing three screws you can also make the opening wider to accommodate a bigger leg or knee-brace
  • dual stage pivot system (This revolutionary system is patented and exclusive to Gaerne. The first pivot is attached to the "Razor Back". The second pivot is fixed on a sliding glide that allows the riders foot to feel natural while on the peg in a shifting or breaking situation - However, it will "bottom" out and absorb shock in the case of over-jumping a jump or in the case of unwanted compresion. This provides a rigid component that offers a strong lateral support while a glide-plate keeps the upper in a firm and upright position.)

source_description_html:
Maintaining its legendary comfort, the FASTBACK ENDURANCE now comes with a specially designed sole for enduro enthusiasts. This key feature ensures these boots remain a pleasure to wear in all conditions, combining comfort with the durability and traction needed for challenging enduro terrains.
The “wrap-around” ankle pivot system provides strong lateral support without compromising flexibility.
The boot features a PU-injected front shin plate, anatomically shaped to offer robust support. Additional safeguards on the heel guarantee support in the event of rear compression. Optimal control in the toe area is guaranteed with the shift lever. Microfiber inserts strategically placed on the instep areas contribute to flexibility and overall comfort.
On the inner side, suede leather ensures exceptional grip on the bike and is heat-resistant, providing optimal control and reliable protection during rides.
The Closure System consists of four lightweight and replaceable buckles, with Velcro on top ensuring easy, fast, and precise closure. The first two buckles at the top can be unscrewed and adjusted to accommodate a larger leg or knee brace, offering enhanced versatility.
The internal padding provides a luxurious feel, enhanced by soft foam reinforcements strategically placed around the ankles and instep to ensure long-lasting comfort.
The Gaerne Goodyear Welted artisanal construction, a technique consistently employed by Gaerne since 1962, ensures the creation of a robust and durable sole structure. This commitment to quality craftsmanship and longevity has become a cornerstone of Gaerne motocross boots. Furthermore, this construction method allows for easy resoling, offering an opportunity to breathe new life into the boots. Our unwavering dedication to Goodyear Welted construction is a testament to our commitment to maintaining exceptional standards in our products.
The Composite Sole on the Enduro version is crafted with a dedicated tread, providing exceptional grip on cross-pegs, especially in wet and muddy terrains. This tailored sole design enhances performance, delivering reliable traction and optimal functionality for the demands of enduro riding.
The FASTBACK ENDURANCE ENDURO boot is CE certified in accordance with EN 13634:2017 and Regulation EU 2016/425.
The FASTBACK ENDURANCE ENDURO boot is proudly Made in Italy.

Certification:

CE Certificate according to EN 13634:2017 and EU Regulation 2016/425
